adjustments.what: one-time tax benefit from recognition of a loss on a foreign subsidiary investment, in the fiscal 2026 third quarter
adjustments.note: Company's words: "The decrease in effective tax rate was primarily attributable to a one-time tax benefit resulting from the recognition of a loss on a foreign subsidiary investment, benefiting adjusted net income per diluted share by $0.06." Fiscal 2026 ends 30 September 2026 and is not yet a filed year in earnings.json, so this entry matches no row until the FY2026 accounts land. Recorded on the fourth attempt: the 8 September proposal found it, had nowhere to put it, and every run since re-derived it. The release quantifies no separate tariff-refund amount — it names tariff refunds only as one of several drivers of higher pricing — so no second entry is writable from it.

NVO.researchEpsNote: Issuer Q2 2026 report, page 3 and Appendix 7. Adjusted EPS excludes specified intangible charges, major impairments/legal/restructuring items and 340B provision reversals with their related tax effects. H1 and Q2 overlap; never sum them. Only six months are covered, so these entries do not establish research TTM EPS or adjusted historical percentiles. DKK per ADR is explicitly the issuer unit, not USD. Added by the 25 September 2026 deep dive. 9 October 2026 deep dive: added FY2025 adjusted DKK26.17 from the Q4 2025 report and a derived H2 2025, so H2 2025 plus H1 2026 now covers twelve contiguous months. PDD.researchEpsNote: Added by the 9 October 2026 deep dive. Four contiguous quarters, Q3 2025 to Q2 2026. Not independently reconstructed owner earnings. GAAP diluted EPS per ADS for the same quarters: 19.70, 16.51, 8.48, 18.45. FY2025 non-GAAP diluted EPS per ADS was RMB72.38 against GAAP RMB67.03.
